newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Cofir to write-off part its shares.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Cofir to write-off part its shares.

text.p: Spain's Corporacion Financiera Reunida Cofir will write-off shares acquired in a buy back which constitute more than four percent of total shares, a spokeswoman said.
The write-off and consequent reduction of capital must be approved by the board, the spokeswoman told Reuters.
Spanish law prohibits a company from holding more than five percent of shares acquired in a buyback.
Cofir appointed as new managers of its board of directors Ramon Blanco Balin, Rodrigo Echenique Gordillo, Oscar Fanjul Salaverri and Alfonso Merry Del Val.
The four new appointments are replacing empty seats after Cerus sold its 48.05 percent stake in Cofir last December. First shareholders in Cofir is now First Fidelity, with a stake of five percent.
